summary: Duplicate Advisory: The reference filter for getRefIDs checks visibility but not the password tier, disclosing that password-protected documents reference a given block
details:
## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-vg99-7gj7-2fr5. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description
SiYuan versions before v3.7.4 contain an information disclosure vulnerability in the /api/block/getRefIDs endpoint that fails to check password-protected document tiers. Unauthenticated readers can discover that password-protected documents reference specific blocks and obtain block identifiers without entering the document password.
